lines.speaker: Oris
lines.text: I found Sam… beneath one of the stone piles.

lines.speaker: Oris
lines.text: I cannot believe it. He's gone! I can't save him anymore because he's GONE!

lines.speaker: Oris
lines.text: You knew it from the start and you DIDN'T think to tell me? You led me on this wild goose chase to...to what?

lines.speaker: Mr. Blob
lines.text: Look, I get it. You're upset.

lines.speaker: Oris
lines.text: Why didn’t you tell me the truth from the beginning?

lines.speaker: Mr. Blob
lines.text: Because you weren't ready to hear it yet.

lines.speaker: Oris
lines.text: I'm angry! You let me chase a ghost!

lines.speaker: Mr. Blob
lines.text: I let you chase hope.

lines.speaker: Oris
lines.text: How could you? You could’ve spared me this pain…

lines.speaker: Mr. Blob
lines.text: But see it this way, now you know and you can overcome it!

lines.speaker: Mr. Blob
lines.text: Sam did not come here just to explore.

lines.speaker: Mr. Blob
lines.text: He searched for a flower… one that could heal even what seems beyond saving.

lines.speaker: Oris
lines.text: A healing flower?

lines.speaker: Mr. Blob
lines.text: It grows only where the sun can't reach.

lines.speaker: Mr. Blob
lines.text: Its petals can mend any wound.

lines.speaker: Mr. Blob
lines.text: Because Sam feared loss more than death.

lines.speaker: Mr. Blob
lines.text: He wanted to bring the flower back to your world.

lines.speaker: Oris
lines.text: So saving others… was his real mission.

lines.speaker: Mr. Blob
lines.text: His greatest wish.

lines.speaker: Oris
lines.text: I'll finish it. I won’t let this be for nothing.

lines.speaker: Mr. Blob
lines.text: Then your path is only beginning.

lines.speaker: Oris
lines.text: It's too late. This won’t bring Sam back…will it?

lines.speaker: Mr. Blob
lines.text: No. But it may save those you haven’t yet lost.

lines.speaker: Mr. Blob
lines.text: Before he vanished, Sam worked nearby.

lines.speaker: Mr. Blob
lines.text: He stored his research inside a cavern system close to here.

lines.speaker: Oris
lines.text: You mean there’s more of his notes?

lines.speaker: Mr. Blob
lines.text: Look closely into the unseaming paths and places. You might be surprised what lays beyond closed paths.

lines.speaker: Mr. Blob
lines.text: Because now you are ready to choose the right option. The option Sam would've wanted for you: to find the flower and save so many people with it.

lines.speaker: Oris
lines.text: If Sam already searched for this flower, he must have stored his aquired information somewhere.

lines.speaker: Oris
lines.text: A cave system yous said? Then that’s where I’ll go.

lines.speaker: Mr. Blob
lines.text: I will help you find the flower when the time comes.
